page.overview:
Who is Reiko Kerevon?

Reiko Kerevon is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

She is stout with long, dark hair in which she wears silver bells.

With a One Power strength level of , Reiko is very weak for an Aes Sedai and therefore stands very low in their hierarchy. She is the third weakest Aes Sedai we know of, with only Marris Thornhill and Daigian Moseneillin beign weaker.

Reiko is an Arafellin. She was born in and is 173 years old.
